{"data":{"postBy":{"databaseId":585,"slug":"how-to-perform-a-simple-protection-spell-for-beginners","date":"2025-02-05T23:24:36","modified":"2025-02-08T01:52:25","title":"How to Perform a Simple Protection Spell for Beginners","excerpt":"

Learn how to cast a protection spell to shield yourself from negative energy and unwanted influences.

","content":"

Protection spells are a fundamental part of magical practices. Whether you need to ward off negativity or create a shield around yourself, this simple spell is easy for beginners to perform.

What You Need

  • A small white candle
  • A bowl of salt
  • A piece of black tourmaline or obsidian
  • Optional: Essential oil (lavender or rosemary)

Step-by-Step Guide

1. Prepare Your Space

Find a quiet place where you won’t be disturbed. Cleanse the area by sprinkling salt or burning incense.

2. Set Your Intention

Hold the candle in your hands and focus on your intention. Visualize a protective light surrounding you.

3. Charge the Candle

If using essential oil, anoint the candle by rubbing a few drops on it. This enhances the spell’s energy.

4. Cast the Spell

Light the candle and say:

“By flame and light, I stand strong. Negative energy, be gone. I am safe, I am free, as I will, so mote it be.”

5. Close the Ritual

Let the candle burn for a few minutes, then extinguish it. Carry the black tourmaline for continued protection.

Final Thoughts

Regular protection spells help maintain balanced energy. Practice this spell whenever you feel the need for extra security.
